title: FA3 vendor-neutral hardware audit and fresh current-host evidence policy
accepted: global hardware policy is vendor-neutral and workload/provider capability based
minimum one CPU package with at least eight physical cores per qualifying CPU
zero to N accelerators with dynamic discovery and no global accelerator minimum
CPU-only hosts and CPU-only workloads conform without accelerator discovery or leases
an accelerator-required workload must obtain an HRB lease for a compatible discovered device
NVIDIA AMD and Intel accelerator families are supported without becoming global admission authorities
NVIDIA DGX is supported as a platform family and not as a separate authority
CUDA ROCm Level Zero oneAPI and other vendor runtime requirements are workload/provider scoped only
HRB remains the exclusive resource admission placement reservation and lease authority
Wayland/X11 and desktop portability are independent cross-cutting gates
current-host hardware evidence must be freshly collected for the host being validated
forbidden: specific workstation or server model as canonical requirement
specific CPU model socket count CPU-ID list or NUMA layout
specific GPU accelerator SKU fixed count VRAM architecture PCI BDF or runtime ordinal
global accelerator-presence requirement for CPU-only hosts or workloads
global CUDA ROCm Level Zero oneAPI or vendor-specific architecture floor
promoting static repository PASS to physical current-host PASS
reusing prior-host physical evidence as evidence for a different or later host state
